mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the bane of local government administration."
Embezzlement of misappropriation is the bane of local government administration.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of settling disputes between two or more persons or groups by a person of high standing respected and acknowledged by the disputing parties."
Mediation is a process of settling disputes between two or more persons or groups by a person of high standing respected and acknowledged by the disputing parties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a second tier process in the quest for justice."
A right of appeal is a second tier process in the quest for justice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creation of the constitution."
The office of the Permanent Secretary is a creation of the constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential characteristic of the civil service."
Neutrality is an essential characteristic of the civil service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known to set up extra judicial bodies to perform the job of administrative adjudication."
Governments all over the world are known to set up extra judicial bodies to perform the job of administrative adjudication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vote by the people to decide an issue."
Referendum A referendum is a vote by the people to decide an issue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Upper Chamber of the National Assembly."
The Senate is the Upper Chamber of the National Assembly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the protectors of fundamental human rights."
The courts are the protectors of fundamental human rights.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the cornerstone of any judgment process."
Fair hearing is the cornerstone of any judgment process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a creation of the Nigerian Constitution."
The Civil Service and the Civil Service Commission are a creation of the Nigerian Constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tenured position and when the incumbent retires from service he retires with his terminal salary."
The office of Permanent Secretary is a tenured position and when the incumbent retires from service he retires with his terminal salary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the grundnorm and mother of all laws in Nigeria."
The constitution is the grundnorm and mother of all laws in Nigeria.
fib: ______ is responsible to the Federal Executive Council.
Federal Civil Service Commission
The Federal Civil Service Commission is responsible to the Federal Executive Council.
______ is the mother of all rights because it is the core of justice.
Right to fair hearing
Right to fair hearing is the mother of all rights because it is the core of justice.
______ may be defined as a section of the government charged with the principal duties of implementing government policies and decisions.
Public Service
Public Service may be defined as a section of the government charged with the principal duties of implementing government policies and decisions.
______ is the Chief Executive Officer of the state where he presides.
absolute monarch
An absolute monarch is the Chief Executive Officer of the state where he presides.
______ is the responsibility of the entire cabinet, first to the parliament and ultimately to the people, for the policies and conduct of the executive arm of government during their term of office.
Ministerial responsibility

Ministerial responsibility is the responsibility of the entire cabinet, first to the parliament and ultimately to the people, for the policies and conduct of the executive arm of government during their term of office.
______ is an administrative body which has the force of law and which is set up to investigate and adjudicate in disputes referred to it.
tribunal
A tribunal is an administrative body which has the force of law and which is set up to investigate and adjudicate in disputes referred to it.
______ is a radical and fundamental tenet of the rule of law and the cornerstone of democracy.
allegation of crime
allegation of crime is a radical and fundamental tenet of the rule of law and the cornerstone of democracy.
______ means an administration that is powered by local government people, charged with the responsibility of conducting business for the local communities in the designated area.
local government administration

Meaning The local government administration means an administration that is powered by local government people, charged with the responsibility of conducting business for the local communities in the designated area.
______ is a process of organizing and executing functions effectively and efficiently in order to achieve the objectives of a nation.
Public Administration
Public Administration is a process of organizing and executing functions effectively and efficiently in order to achieve the objectives of a nation.
______ means that a country is governed by civil law or regular law, that is, laws which are reasonably justifiable in a democratic society, as opposed to draconian, oppressive and arbitrary laws.
Rule of law

Rule of law means that a country is governed by civil law or regular law, that is, laws which are reasonably justifiable in a democratic society, as opposed to draconian, oppressive and arbitrary laws.
______ means every branch, arm, department, authority, agency, or institution of government and the people who work for them.
civil service
The civil service means every branch, arm, department, authority, agency, or institution of government and the people who work for them.
______ is a writ for securing the liberty or immediate release of a person from unlawful custody or other unjustifiable detention.
habeas corpus
A habeas corpus is a writ for securing the liberty or immediate release of a person from unlawful custody or other unjustifiable detention.

______ is an independent and objective body that receives and investigates complaints sent to it by members of the public seeking to obtain remedy for perceived wrongs done to them by alleged wrong doers.
Public Complaints Commission

The Public Complaints Commission is an independent and objective body that receives and investigates complaints sent to it by members of the public seeking to obtain remedy for perceived wrongs done to them by alleged wrong doers.
